hunks.baseline: “Yes. You did.”

hunks.sol: “Do you intend to see this through to the end? Here and now?”

hunks.sol: In my mind, I had killed Michael Silbert dozens of times already. Broken his limbs, crushed his mouth, ripped out his heart and burst it in my hand.

hunks.baseline: But this was not the Murim.
hunks.sol: But this wasn’t Murim.

hunks.baseline: An unmistakable note of amusement seeped into the dry voice that followed.

hunks.sol: It felt as though something sticky and repulsive had reached out and seized my limbs. The horrible sensation of being dragged into a deep swamp made me knock his blade away on reflex.

hunks.baseline: That horrifying sensation of being dragged into a deep swamp made me reflexively knock the sword blade away.

hunks.sol: Our two energies mingled for an instant.

hunks.baseline: Finally, in a flash of light, familiar faces flickered before my eyes. Before I even realized it, I was staggering and breathing harshly.

hunks.baseline: I did not want to admit it. I could not admit it.
hunks.sol: I didn’t want to admit it. I couldn’t.

hunks.baseline: And yet… at the same time, I had no choice but to admit it.
hunks.sol: And yet… I had to.

hunks.baseline: Michael Silbert.
hunks.sol: Michael Silbert was right.

hunks.baseline: Everything he had said was true.
The moment I severed the life of that man calmly staring at me, seemingly unconcerned with the blood on his neck, my life and the lives of my people would be cut down with it.
hunks.sol: The moment I ended the life of the man watching me so calmly, as though the blood on his neck meant nothing, I would cut short my own life and the lives of everyone close to me.

hunks.baseline: They would burn into ashes and disappear without a trace, just like the countless enemies I had defeated until now.
hunks.sol: Like the countless enemies I had defeated, they would burn to ash and vanish without a trace.

hunks.baseline: “May I take your silence to mean that my guess was correct?”
hunks.sol: “May I take your silence to mean I was right?”

hunks.baseline: I remained silent, and Michael Silbert smiled.
hunks.sol: I said nothing. Michael Silbert smiled.

hunks.baseline: “I look forward to working with you. I will contact you again soon.”
hunks.sol: “I look forward to working with you. I’ll be in touch soon.”

hunks.baseline: With a smile that showed he was certain of his victory, he extended his hand.
hunks.sol: He held out his hand, smiling like a man certain of victory.

hunks.baseline: I never took it. Instead, I turned away.
hunks.sol: I turned away without taking it.

hunks.baseline: Tonight, the moonlight never reached Munich.
hunks.sol: No moonlight came to Munich that night.

hunks.sol: Huginn watched him disappear into the darkness, then spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Everyone has a weakness. And he possesses one more fatal than anyone else’s.”
hunks.sol: “Everyone has a weakness. His is more dangerous than most.”

hunks.baseline: “Emotion. Jin Taekyung is more emotional than anyone.”
hunks.sol: “His feelings. Jin Taekyung is more emotional than anyone.”

hunks.baseline: His calm voice continued.
hunks.sol: Michael continued in the same calm voice.

hunks.baseline: “Someone whose joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure are so clear is easier to handle than a materialistic person. Wealth and honor can be regained even after they are lost, but people cannot.”
hunks.sol: “Someone whose joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure are so plain to see is easier to handle than someone motivated by greed. Wealth and honor can be regained. People can’t.”
